usage.useWhen: A page where visitors should write to the site owner without opening a mail program, usually the contact page. The fields are name, email and message.
usage.avoidWhen: Forms with other fields, uploads or stored entries; use a form plugin inside leitvia/form-errors. Not for a newsletter sign-up.
usage.a11y: Visible labels, an error summary that takes the focus and links to each field, messages at the fields with aria-invalid and aria-describedby. It works without JavaScript.
